editorial:
Imagine waking up in a hospital with no idea who you are, only to find out a giant company basically rebuilt your brain. That is exactly what happens to Luke Gibson. After a nasty accident, the Hexx Corporation puts a high-tech chip in his head called a Psi-Comp. At first, it seems like a miracle that saved his life, but you quickly realize that the chip gives the company way too much control. It feels like a classic tech-thriller where the hero is just a pawn in a much bigger, scarier game. You get a nice mix of mystery and high-stakes energy that keeps you guessing about Luke's real identity.

The action scenes are snappy and the plot twists keep things moving so you never get bored. While some of the special effects look a bit dated, the acting is solid enough to make you care about Luke's struggle. If you enjoy stories about corporate greed and mind control, you will love this one. You should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a fan of physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is a great way to keep this hidden gem.
endingExplained: In the end, Luke discovers the company wants to use the chip to control people's minds on a massive scale. He fights back against the Hexx Corporation in a final showdown to stop their plan. After a lot of fighting, Luke manages to take down the villains and disable the system. He finally gets his freedom back and ensures the dangerous technology cannot be used to enslave others, bringing the corporate conspiracy to a crashing halt.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about rogue AI and evil corporations.
